runtime.note: A single native binary plus the SQLite native lib beside it. The host needs no .NET runtime.

commands.name: systemctl
commands.why: the daemon is a systemd unit and deploy verifies it through systemctl

system.why: a person signs in against this provider directly, over TCP

units.note: One unit, unprivileged. A package runs it as the tks-auth system user; a checkout deploy runs it as the deploying user. It reads and writes the account store in its state directory and binds an unprivileged port.

secrets.why: every token is signed with it, and every application verifies against its public half
secrets.note: Generated once, on a machine that has none, and never shipped by any package. Replacing it invalidates every session that exists.
